title: Amazon, Meta CapEx Drives Record $45 Billion Data Center Construction Boom, Overtaking Office Build With 29% Jump - Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN)
summary: The article discusses a significant shift in corporate America's physical space utilization, with a surge in data center construction and a decline in traditional office spaces, influenced by the AI revolution and remote work trends. Additionally, it touches on the performance of tech stocks like Amazon and Meta amidst these market changes.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive due to the strong growth in data center construction and the AI-driven economic reshaping, despite the underperformance of tech stocks and the decline in traditional office construction.
